name: Context Retrieval and Context Minimization program for Rust code

mentions.name: Context Retrieval and Context Minimization program for Rust code
mentions.description: This tool automates context retrieval and minimization for Rust code when working with LLMs. Programmers specify exactly what to fetch into the context window for a one-question/one-answer exchange: sig(function) fetches only the signature, @function captures the whole body, and sig(Struct) or sig(Trait) fetches the fields and signatures of all methods. It currently calls ast-grep under the hood, with plans to move to tree-sitter queries, and deliberately avoids giving the AI a whole view of the codebase, only the necessary points specified by the programmer.
mentions.problem: Manually opening files and copying function/method signatures from all over the place is tedious, and giving the AI more information than needed confuses it, degrades accuracy, and makes calls slower and more expensive.
mentions.audience: This targets programmers who use LLMs in their coding workflow; context is specified by the programmer.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am writing a Context Retrieval and Context Minimization program for Rust code. I am trying to automate my own workflow in how I use LLMs.
